channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: Российскую компанию впервые успешно атаковал искусственный интеллект
item.description: Lenta News: A Russian company was reportedly successfully attacked by AI for the first time; likely the same event as item 5.

item.title: В России расследовали удачную кибератаку, которую полностью провел ИИ
item.description: Газета: Russian investigators reportedly examined a successful cyberattack carried out entirely by AI.

item.title: Piratage Binance : 6,3 Md$ volés, la Corée du Nord visée

item.title: Claude за 53 минуты создала эксплойт для 11-летней уязвимости Linux
item.description: Компьютерра: Claude reportedly built an exploit for an 11-year-old Linux vulnerability in 53 minutes.

item.title: North Korea’s Hackers Supercharge Crypto Heists With AI Skills
item.description: Bloomberg: Bloomberg reports North Korean hackers are using AI skills to boost crypto heists; no details given in the headline.

item.title: Desinformación 'midterms' EE.UU.: de anuncios creados con IA a acusaciones sin pruebas de fraude electoral
item.description: RTVE.es: RTVE overview of US midterm disinformation, from AI-created ads to unproven fraud claims.

item.title: Anthropic’s Claude AI found ways to hack Chrome, Android, Windows and Linux
item.description: MediaNama: MediaNama reports Anthropic's Claude AI found ways to hack Chrome, Android, Windows and Linux.

item.title: New VOLTA Infostealer Uses Claude, Gemini, and Kimi AI to Rank Victims by Financial Value

item.title: What is Volta-Autodoxer, new AI-enhanced malware profiling victims for hackers in seconds?
item.description: The Indian Express: Explainer on Volta-Autodoxer, AI-enhanced malware that profiles victims for hackers.

item.title: VOLTA: El Malware Que Usa IA Para Calcular Cuánto Vales
item.description: ElPeriodico.digital: Spanish-language coverage of VOLTA malware that uses AI to estimate the value of victims' stolen data.

item.title: Binance dépense plus de 6,34 milliards de dollars pour atténuer les conséquences de la cyberattaque.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Binance reportedly spent over $6.34 billion to mitigate the aftermath of a cyberattack already tracked as AI-assisted.

item.title: New VOLTA Infostealer Uses Claude, Gemini, and Kimi AI to Profile Victims and Rank Stolen Data
item.description: GBHackers: VOLTA infostealer uses Claude, Gemini and Kimi to profile victims and rank stolen data.

item.title: Chainalysis reports security breach involving offensive agentic techniques
item.description: SC Media: Chainalysis reports a security breach involving offensive agentic AI techniques.

item.title: PrivacyFlow: Privacy in AI Agents through Information Flow Analysis and Consequence-Aware Risk Management

item.title: Prevented is Not Protected: What Attack Success Rate Hides about RAG
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper argues that attack success rate hides weaknesses in defenses against RAG knowledge poisoning.

item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents ADS-OT, an adaptive security framework for operational technology facing AI-driven attackers.

item.title: Accept Changes, Reject Attacks: Robust Memory Management for LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes robust memory management for LLM agents to accept legitimate changes and reject attacks.

item.title: PP-Mark: Provable and Publicly Verifiable Watermarking for Generative AI
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper PP-Mark proposes publicly verifiable watermarking for generative AI that resists forgery and adversarial optimization.

item.title: Erase the Injected Region: Multimodal Prompt-Injection Defense with On-Policy Self-Distillation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes a defense against multimodal indirect prompt injection that keeps the model's use of task-relevant media.

item.title: Simple Features Beat Most AI Control Monitors
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper finds simple features outperform most AI control monitors at separating honest from backdoored code.

item.title: What Standard Evaluations Hide About Detectors of Hijacked LLM Agents: Rare Attacks, Unseen Tools and Benchmark Transfer
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv audit finds standard evaluations of hijacked-LLM-agent detectors hide weaknesses with rare attacks and unseen tools.

item.title: How Much Can Tool Calls Reveal About You? Privacy Leakage from Tool-Call Traces
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies how much MCP tool-call traces of LLM agents reveal about users.

item.title: Characterizing Recoverable Expert-Utilization Signatures in Fine-Tuned Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper characterizes recoverable expert-utilization signatures in fine-tuned Mixture-of-Experts LLMs as a security risk.

item.title: STRIATUM-CTF: A Protocol-Driven Agentic Framework for Autonomous CTF Solving
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper STRIATUM-CTF presents an LLM agent framework for autonomously solving capture-the-flag security challenges.

item.title: The Guard That Cried Wolf: How Scary Words Make Agent Guardrails Refuse Legitimate Actions
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows alarming wording makes agent guardrails refuse legitimate, authorized actions.

item.title: The Envelope Layer: An Underestimated Surface of LLM Agent Defense
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper examines the envelope layer as an underestimated attack surface for LLM agent defense.

item.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies whether secrets in a model's context window are inadvertently leaked by language models.
